After making a thread about the social gameplay of star citizen I started to think about how the individual social interactions might play out. This will be a little theory crafting but mostly discussion on how the community thinks they might, eventually, be interacting with total strangers in game. CIG has an opportunity to bring a dynamic social experience with out reinventing the wheel or costing millions on building features if they do this right.

My personal experience in multiplayer games leads me to think that Star Citizen will fall somewhere between DayZ and WoW in terms of social interaction. My greatest fear is that they will lean to much towards one or the other. I love DayZ but the sociopath tendencies of that game are just a bit to much for a game like star citizen built around the idea that you can enjoy the game with your friends, it works for the survival genera but I don't think it will work well with the space sim genera. If they lean to much on the canned side of social interaction like WoW, and its many clones, I feel like many people will be turned off from participating socially entirely.

But what do you think? How do you envision the social interactions with other people?

I imagine we will have a lot of freedom. We will have a form of VOIP, so people will hear voices near to them. I also believe are actions won't be restricted, but there will be repurcussions. For example. In dayz there is no real limiting condition to being a sociopath. You kill someone plantside in UEE sec. Space and you are going to be detained or killed pretty fast, if you can't escape somehow. I think this will make for good dynamic social development. People can grow how they want, but there is enough control to not let it get out of hand.

I agree but there also needs to be a chance, as slim as it may be, that someone could murder a player planetside and escape justice. That being said the consequences should be enough that if people wanted to play the sociopath they should have to pause for a moment or their play would be more difficult than others. Sociopaths help mix up gameplay IMO to an interesting level, just not when they are the majority of the population.

Oh I absolutely agree. I think if a person knows how to kill quietly, has some sort of escape, or has maybe tipped the guard to make an exit to a ship faster then they should get away. That makes it all more alive.
